insights: State Contractor Licensing: Virginia requires contractors to be licensed through DPOR Virginia Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation (DPOR) licenses contractors—verify at dpor.virginia.gov. Class A is required for projects over $120,000; Class B for $10,000-$120,000; Class C for under $10,000.

Humidity & Moisture Management: Virginia Humidity runs high from May through September. Reddit emphasizes proper ventilation, dehumidification in basements and crawl spaces, and moisture-resistant materials.

Northern Virginia Costs: NoVA (Fairfax, Arlington, Loudoun) has very high construction costs Labor and material costs in NoVA are 30-40% above state averages. Reddit warns that lowball bids usually mean unlicensed labor. Permit requirements in Fairfax County are extensive.
Historic District Restrictions: Virginia has numerous historic districts with exterior renovation rules Alexandria, Richmond
